title: Lumen Reach 0.8.0 -> 0.8.1: Rime Vault ceiling slot closed
subtitle: Exact poses, private Intel nested, Medium 0.5 scale, core 49c8408; release packages (format 0.7); columns differ only by package.

rows.title: Rime Vault spawn, looking up at the north edge
rows.caption: 0.8.0: the ceiling and side shells stopped 2 m short of the floor edge; day sky shows directly overhead (check-sky enclosure: 290 sky rays from 49 eyes). 0.8.1: ceiling and shells reach the edge; the opening is framed by the ceiling.

rows.title: Mid-vault, looking north through the designed opening
rows.caption: The wide north opening onto the vista is intended and unchanged; the strip above it is now ceiling.

rows.title: Walking view toward the north threshold
rows.caption: Walking pitch: the slot itself was only visible looking up near the north edge; the extended west shell now frames the upper left, the vista through the opening is unchanged.
